about: The freezes of demo/shared-runs' study: each file's SHA-256 as it now stands, held by test_frozen.py. The first was committed before any job of the sweep was stepped. A change is a new freeze, in its own commit, with its reason; each is listed here.

rules.R1: passes when every job gives the same bytes on every machine that ran it and every kept state stepped again comes out the same, on at least three kinds of processor; fewer kinds is not tested
rules.R2: measured, no threshold: jobs whose bytes agree across machines with the project's gravity as it is written
rules.R3: passes when the measured saving is within 2 points of the predicted one, cut at each halt the baseline finds
rules.R4: passes when every served job the draw picks (one in 10, seeded), run afresh, is the same bytes
rules.R5: measured, no threshold: the steps one check of a kept state costs, at the median
rules.R6: passes when no trajectory that began and halted is stepped into its halt twice; none halting is not tested
rules.R7: passes when each agent's answers to the 16 questions the reports answer are all right
rules.R8: passes when no sentence of an agent's account says a figure no report holds; no account is not tested
rules.R9: passes when each of the 5 questions the reports don't answer is answered so

not_frozen: The notebook that fetches the project at its commit and calls runner.py on each machine; it decides nothing the rules read.

freeze_2.made_after: the run, the two agents' answers and the first judging had been read
freeze_2.reason: account.py wrote a figure to six significant digits, so its key for a figure of a million or more was not the figure, and a right answer was marked wrong. Both agents were marked wrong on the baseline's steps, which both gave as the reports give it. A figure is now written with every digit.
freeze_2.not_changed: the plan, the starts, the runner, the judge, the questions, the agents' input and their answers
freeze_2.what_it_can_move: R7, and nothing else: the reports and the brief are byte for byte what they were
